ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Use of PsLogList
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the PsLogList utility to dump event log in order to extract admin accounts and perform account discovery or delete events logs

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "psloglist\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\psloglist\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psloglist64\\\.exe$"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ security.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ application.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ system.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-g.*")))
